correctness.rationale: For every positive side triple the projected box is a three-generator planar zonotope with half-perimeter sum a_i sqrt(1-U_i^2). Spherical one/two-index moments yield exact triangular formulas for observed moments m1,m2,m3. The m2 coefficient is strictly positive by E(X1-X2)^2>0. The m3 coefficient is strictly negative since beta^2<=4/21 and 4/sqrt(21)<9pi/32. Newton identities give unique positive roots with multiplicities. Explicit positive noncongruent triples with the same first two power sums show minimality. Standalone direct hull checker passed 320 random-view cases and algebraic consistency checks; finite diagnostics are not substitutes for proof.

None of the inspected full results supplies the missing third marginal perimeter coefficient or its nonzero sign.

value.rationale: A complete, sharp, natural inverse geometric-tomography statement: three orientation-free marginal perimeter moments recover a 3-parameter body family whereas two do not. Its nontrivial ingredient is rigorous universal nondegeneracy of the third all-distinct spherical moment coefficient; the result distinguishes true recovery from known lower-moment formulas, without requiring stronger theorems or numerical surveys.
